patch_description: Deterministic maximin search for 13 Heilbronn points using the fixed unit-simplex normalization from the stronger prior implementation. The rewrite improves initialization through multiple reproducible simplex samples, including boundary-aware seeds, and uses a mixed mutation population: ordinary local moves, bottleneck-triangle-focused moves, and occasional coordinated multi-point perturbations. A temperature-controlled soft-min objective preserves broad optimization early while progressively prioritizing the true smallest triangle area. All proposals are projected back into the reference simplex, guaranteeing a convex unit-area hull and valid output shape.
